title: GemSim versioned KFD/DRM operation envelope
scope: typed libhsakmt shim transport and daemon-owned KFD/DRM operation envelope; this is not a host KFD, ROCr, HIP, OpenCL, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, or hardware-device claim

capability.name: KMT_OPERATION_V1
capability.negotiation: selected if and only if offered and required by the client; required-not-offered is the base subset failure; absence returns UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY and creates no KMT owner or object state

transport.crc: base protocol CRC-32C over the complete frame
transport.ancillary_descriptors: exactly one writable shared-backing memfd for EXPORT_BACKING; zero for every other operation

shared_backing_layout.ownership: The model facade allocates ordinary file-backed spans only below the reserved tail. Exactly one process doorbell allocation owns the complete reserved tail. The first 128 eight-byte slots carry upstream doorbell values and the next 128 eight-byte slots carry bridge-retired packet counts. Doorbells are initialized to UINT64_MAX so the first legal upstream value zero is observable; completion slots are initialized to zero. USERPTR tokens are not file offsets. The daemon independently validates every scalar offset against this layout before publishing GPU-VA access.

clock_correlation.sample_policy: one nonzero daemon-global simulated-time sample is returned for GPU, CPU, and system; repeated observations never decrease

fields.name: object_generation
fields.constraint: paired-with-object_id; never used as a pointer

fields.name: arg_words
fields.constraint: operation-specific scalar words; no pointer encoding

fields.name: copied_crc32c
fields.constraint: CRC-32C of exactly copied_bytes in copied_buffer

fields.name: copied_buffer
fields.constraint: only copied value bytes; bytes after copied_bytes are zero

fields.name: status
fields.constraint: source HSAKMT status; protocol rejection is represented in wire_status

fields.name: wire_status
fields.constraint: zero only when status is a committed provider result

fields.name: result_crc32c
fields.constraint: CRC-32C of exactly result_bytes in copied_result

fields.name: copied_result
fields.constraint: only committed result bytes; bytes after result_bytes are zero

OPEN_KFD.purpose: create a daemon-owned virtual KFD session; never opens /dev/kfd

CLOSE_KFD.purpose: close the caller-owned virtual KFD session after child objects are gone

GET_VERSION.purpose: return daemon model KFD version metadata

TOPOLOGY_SNAPSHOT.purpose: return a copied daemon-owned topology snapshot

ALLOC_MEMORY.purpose: allocate daemon-owned simulated memory and return handle/generation

COPY_MEMORY.purpose: copy bytes through the fixed copied buffer; no host pointer or descriptor

QUEUE_DOORBELL.purpose: ring a daemon-owned queue control path with scalar arguments

POINTER_INFO.purpose: query daemon-owned simulated pointer metadata from the allocation handle; no host pointer is encoded

MODEL_DRM_CALL.purpose: invoke one source-defined model DRM command through copied bytes

PROCESS_APERTURES.purpose: page fixed-width process aperture records without serializing the upstream output pointer

ACQUIRE_VM.purpose: bind one logical GPU and render-minor identity to the owner session without serializing a render FD

SET_MEMORY_POLICY.purpose: set the standard KFD cache policy and alternate aperture for one logical GPU without serializing a pointer

ALLOC_MEMORY_OF_GPU.purpose: allocate a GPU-visible daemon-owned range with a caller-selected VA and an opaque facade-owned backing-store offset

MAP_MEMORY_TO_GPU.purpose: map an allocation to a bounded copied list of logical GPUs

UNMAP_MEMORY_FROM_GPU.purpose: unmap an allocation from a bounded copied list of logical GPUs

SET_SCRATCH_BACKING_VA.purpose: register a page-aligned scratch backing virtual address for one logical GPU

EXPORT_BACKING.purpose: transfer ownership of exactly one process-owned shared memfd duplicate to the bridge; allocation GPU VAs remain bound to scalar backing offsets

GET_CLOCK_COUNTERS.purpose: return one coherent monotonic simulated nanosecond clock correlation for a logical GPU

cp0010_implementation_table.source_compatibility_boundary: The 27 translated upstream operation wrappers cover representative source calls. EXPORT_BACKING is a project-owned model/bridge operation and is not an upstream libhsakmt symbol. Unwrapped source symbols remain explicit NOT_SUPPORTED through provider metadata/invoke.
envelope_implemented: copied-buffer length, zero-padding, and CRC validation
cp0010_implementation_table.unsupported_rule: The typed wrapper and fixed envelope are implemented even when the selected daemon operation is not. After complete validation, an unavailable operation returns wire_status OK plus HSAKMT_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED and leaves every owner/object/generation/buffer unchanged. Later checkpoints may move individual operation names out of this list only with retained runtime evidence.

operation_layout_rules.word_byte_order: big-endian u32 words; adjacent high/low words encode a u64 as high word then low word only where explicitly named
operation_layout_rules.unused_words: every request arg_words and result_words index not listed for the selected operation is zero
operation_layout_rules.flags: flags is zero for every CP-0010 operation
operation_layout_rules.buffer: copied_bytes is exactly the selected operation's request buffer size; copied_crc32c covers those bytes; unused tail bytes are zero
operation_layout_rules.result: result_bytes is zero on every wire or provider failure and for operations with result_buffer none; result CRC is zero when result_bytes is zero
operation_layout_rules.handle_pair: each required object or aux ID has its adjacent nonzero generation; an absent pair is all zero

OPEN_KFD.owner: zero request; new nonzero owner_id/owner_generation only on success

TOPOLOGY_SNAPSHOT.object: zero request; result object_id is node_id and object_generation equals header job_epoch

ALLOC_MEMORY.object: zero request; new allocation ID/generation only on success

request_buffer.bytes: equals byte_count for HOST_TO_SIM; zero for SIM_TO_HOST

result_buffer.bytes: equals byte_count for SIM_TO_HOST; zero for HOST_TO_SIM

QUEUE_CREATE.object: zero request; new queue ID/generation only on success

EVENT_CREATE.object: zero request; new event ID/generation only on success

request_buffer.bytes: exact pinned command argument size from model_callback_policy.drm_command_argument_bytes

result_buffer.bytes: at most result_capacity and exact copied command result layout; pointer-bearing upstream outputs are translated to bytes or fixed IDs

ALLOC_MEMORY_OF_GPU.object: zero request; new allocation pair only on success
ALLOC_MEMORY_OF_GPU.ownership: The facade that owns the file-backed mapping allocates ordinary non-userptr offsets below the reserved doorbell tail. A DOORBELL allocation must exactly cover that tail. USERPTR preserves the overloaded caller address token. After EXPORT_BACKING the daemon validates every scalar against shared_backing_layout and returns it unchanged; it never derives file offsets from GPU virtual addresses.

EXPORT_BACKING.ownership: The sender retains its original descriptor and transfers one duplicate. The receiver validates and owns the received descriptor until owner disconnect. No host descriptor number is serialized.

GET_CLOCK_COUNTERS.clock_domain: The daemon samples one nonzero strictly monotonic simulated nanosecond counter and returns that identical sample for GPU, CPU, and system. The system frequency is exactly 1000000000 Hz. Host-native profiling timestamps use the same sampler.

deterministic_fixture.name: CP-0010-one-node-gfx950

first_objects.id_rule: fixed ASCII type prefix in the high 24 bits plus a one-based slot in the remaining 40 bits
first_objects.generation_rule: equals the fixture job_epoch; reuse in a later epoch receives that epoch and stale epoch pairs are rejected

deterministic_fixture.rule: The topology record hex uses job_epoch 1. A test with any other negotiated nonzero job_epoch replaces only bytes 8 through 15 with that big-endian u64 and recomputes CRC-32C; object_generation echoes the same job_epoch.

model_callback_policy.hardware_command_policy: IDs 8 through 14 are source ABI records only. GemSim validates their copied bytes and returns HSAKMT_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED; it never opens or returns a render node, FD, device handle, or production DRM object.
model_callback_policy.encoding: operation IDs 1 through 28 select typed daemon operations; MODEL_DRM_CALL ID 18 uses arg_words[0] as the DRM command ID, while PROCESS_APERTURES and ACQUIRE_VM never serialize an upstream pointer or render FD
model_callback_policy.negotiation: KFD_IOCTL and DRM_CALL accept exactly 1.1 as frozen provider/model metadata before an operation is sent; any other model pair is UNSUPPORTED_VERSION until a new envelope revision records compatibility
model_callback_policy.callback_ownership: the operation ID is an enum selector, not an address; no function address, shared-library name, dlsym result, or host pointer crosses the wire
model_callback_policy.drm_command: MODEL_DRM_CALL arg_words[0] selects one of the 15 source-defined DRM command IDs 0 through 14; its argument bytes are copied_buffer and are validated against the pinned command layout before callback
model_callback_policy.model_absence: if the daemon has no model implementation, return status HSAKMT_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED with wire_status zero after validation; do not invoke a production fallback

status_encoding.transport_status: result.wire_status uses protocol/host-transport-v1.json statuses; -1 means no wire status was decoded, and zero means the provider status is authoritative
status_encoding.provider_status: result.status preserves the pinned HSAKMT status enum for an admitted operation; provider NOT_SUPPORTED is a deterministic operation result, not a transport error
status_encoding.success: wire_status zero and status HSAKMT_STATUS_SUCCESS are required before publishing any returned handle, bytes, or state transition
status_encoding.protocol_failure: wire_status nonzero; status is HSAKMT_STATUS_SUCCESS only as canonical initialization; operation identity fields echo the decoded request where correlation is safe; result bytes and all newly allocated identities are zero

error_precedence: DROP_AND_CLOSE invalid base envelope, CRC, message type, fixed record/payload length, header reserved field, uncorrelatable request, MSG_TRUNC, MSG_CTRUNC, ancillary data, or unsafe descriptor state
MALFORMED KMT flags, payload reserved fields, operation ID, callback ID, fixed-width field, copied length, copied padding, copied CRC, or ancillary descriptor cardinality
UNSUPPORTED_VERSION KMT envelope version or model callback version
PROTOCOL_STATE connection ID, job epoch state, or non-increasing session request/operation sequence
UNAUTHORIZED owner identity or callback policy
INVALID_HANDLE stale, foreign, destroyed, zero, or generation-mismatched object/aux handle
INVALID_PARAMETER operation-specific argument, node, command, or result capacity
RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED daemon-owned object, memory, queue, event, or copied-buffer limit
provider operation status after all validation and ownership checks
INTERNAL daemon callback, event-queue, or transport failure

atomicity.validation: decode and validate the complete fixed payload, copied CRC, version, identity, capability, ownership, and operation constraints before callback or state mutation
atomicity.unsupported_call: a validated but unavailable operation returns wire_status zero/status HSAKMT_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED (or explicitly mapped NOT_IMPLEMENTED) and changes no owner, handle, generation, allocation, queue, event, model, or output bytes
atomicity.failure: any non-success provider result has no externally visible partial state; newly created IDs, result bytes, and output fields remain zero
atomicity.result_copy: daemon copies result bytes into a fresh fixed result payload before ACK construction; caller publishes bytes only after status, lengths, CRC, identity, and operation correlation pass
atomicity.sequence: a structurally valid request consumes operation_sequence exactly once even when the provider returns an error; each malformed or dropped record does not advance it; sequence exhaustion fails without wrap

identity_and_handles.width: all IDs and generations on the wire are big-endian u64; no pointer-sized or ABI-dependent handle is serialized
identity_and_handles.ownership: owner_id/owner_generation identify the KMT session; object and aux pairs are scoped to that owner and the negotiated daemon instance
identity_and_handles.generation: generations are nonzero, daemon-lifetime monotonic, never wrap, and change on slot reuse
identity_and_handles.disconnect: disconnect invalidates all owner-scoped objects and suppresses later ACKs; daemon cleanup is deterministic and does not emit a replay
identity_and_handles.fd_policy: only EXPORT_BACKING accepts exactly one SCM_RIGHTS descriptor; it must be a same-UID writable regular memfd with exact size, CLOEXEC, and shrink/grow seals. No numeric descriptor value is serialized or returned; dma-buf, render-node, device, and every other ancillary descriptor remain forbidden

forbidden_scope: raw host pointers or pointer-sized integers
host file descriptors other than the single validated EXPORT_BACKING memfd, dma-buf descriptors, render-node handles, or device handles
production libhsakmt, libdrm, libdrm_amdgpu, AMDGPU UMD, or amdsmi loading/linking
implicit host fallback, ioctl forwarding, or device discovery
acceptance_boundary: This authority freezes the KMT v5 wire contract, shared-backing layout, and validation policy. EXPORT_BACKING plus allocation and queue offsets prove only bounded shared-storage identity after focused transport/state tests; GET_CLOCK_COUNTERS adds one simulated nanosecond correlation domain. These contracts do not prove AQL consumption, HIP, OpenCL, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang, or model execution. Those require child code and retained runtime evidence.
